scope: Source-semantic candidate approval for one fixed1 bookkeeping branch per exact physical item; not runtime execution, activation permission, spell/effect implementation, terminal transition or recovery.
fullSnapshotHashMethod: SHA256(JSON.stringify(recursivelySorted(entire normalized Entry))) using exact existing JavaScript itemChargeSourceSnapshot recipe, canonical ID and input revision included. Transport alias/revision handling remains existing source contract.
clauseHashMethod: Same exact JS recursively sorted JSON hash of the specified source clause; no source prose included.
